objective: Reduce pose error and abstention through actual multiview depth evidence while retaining occlusion uncertainty; no truth input online
disclosure: Existing final top-view frames were inspected before declaration; new held-out camera views and intermediate frames have not been rendered or tuned on. This is held-out-view replay evaluation, not independent physical episodes.
frame_selection: 13 equally spaced recorded configurations including endpoints, all robot lanes
matched_conditions: remove leftmost20% of each measured component pixels
candidate: observability-aware sensor-only sequential association and covariance fusion across calibrated views
limits: No artificial confidence promotion on absent axes
No GPU training unless dataset supports meaningful held-out evaluation

development_amendment.reason: Oblique views contain adjacent cells; RGB silhouette mismatch leaves a few background-depth pixels in color components. Identified only in development split.
development_amendment.all_methods_cell_roi: Fixed camera look-at center = calibrated position +2.5m*forward; XY halfwidth0.7m; same boundary for every method
development_amendment.candidate_consensus: Initial known-box hypothesis rejects pixels with abs surface distance>8mm only if at least70% remain; rerun frozen fit on consensus; retain rejection counts
development_amendment.extra_baseline: single-view robust geometry isolates trimming from additional sensing
